<h1>Membership Operations: One-Page Summary</h1>
<p class="lede">For the election and membership committee. Updated October 21, 2026.</p>
<h2>How it works</h2>
<ol class="steps">
<li><b>Monthly report.</b> The treasurer pulls a QuickBooks report of giving for the giving year (Dec 1 to Nov 30). Each row shows Individual or Household only, never an amount. Records are matched on the exact street address as entered; people who may share a household get a group number.</li>
<li><b>Committee scrub.</b> The committee reviews each group and decides whether to combine, keep separate or change. This is a manual step. The scrubbed list is loaded into the central repository (a Google Sheet for now), which skips anyone already invited.</li>
<li><b>Invitations.</b> Mailchimp sends one email a month with an Individual or Household link. Only the primary receives it. One reminder goes out 14 days later.</li>
<li><b>Registration.</b> The primary completes the form. A household primary adds spouse, children and parents. Every member needs a unique email. Children outside 18 to 26 are saved but are not members and are not emailed. The link is marked used on submit.</li>
<li><b>Confirmation.</b> Each member on the registration, including spouse and dependents, gets an email with the information captured and the committee contact, memberships@alsalamfoundation.org. Changes go through the committee only.</li>
</ol>
<h2>Rules we are working to</h2>
<table class="tbl"><tr><th>Individual</th><td>$600+ in the giving year</td></tr>
<tr><th>Household</th><td>$1,200+; spouses at the same street address are combined</td></tr>
<tr><th>Membership</th><td>Starts the following Dec 1, lasts one year, restarts each year</td></tr>
<tr><th>Link expiry</th><td>Earliest of submit, 60 days, or Dec 10. Last QuickBooks pull is Nov 30. Unused expired links are re-invited at the next send.</td></tr>
<tr><th>Upgrade</th><td>An individual who reaches the household level gets a household link and the record is upgraded</td></tr>
<tr><th>Children</th><td>Age counted on Dec 1: 18 to 26 are eligible members; under 18 or 27+ are saved, not members</td></tr>
<tr><th>Parents</th><td>Honor system confirmation</td></tr>
<tr><th>Identity</th><td>Unique email per member; no logins or passwords</td></tr>
<tr><th>Privacy</th><td>Donation amounts appear nowhere; tier only</td></tr>
<tr><th>Size</th><td>About 200 households, assumed 4 voting people on average (about 800)</td></tr></table>
<h2>Out of scope for now</h2>
<ul><li>Voting process and flow</li><li>Renewals, mid-year reminders and lapse notices</li><li>A CRM (the repository must stay exportable for one later)</li></ul>
<h2>Open decisions</h2>
<ul><li><b>D1</b> deferred</li><li><b>D4</b> in-kind gifts and matches</li><li><b>D5</b> household primary after a combine</li><li><b>D7</b> monthly calendar and backup</li><li><b>D8</b> Nov 30 cutoff: gift date or QuickBooks entry date</li><li><b>D9</b> mid-year changes</li><li><b>D15</b> who builds and owns the Sheet script</li></ul>
<h2>Next</h2>
<p>Software: requirements list, then build versus buy, then a vendor scorecard.</p>
